questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct? 60 × 4 + 9 ÷ 3 - 8 = 34
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

60 × 4 + 9 ÷ 3 - 8 = 34
questions.solution:
4. ÷ and × 

60 ÷ 4 + 9 × 3 - 8 = 34

⇒ 15 + 27 - 8 = 34

⇒ 42 - 8 = 34

⇒ 34 = 34

Hence, ‘÷ and × ’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: The ratio between the monthly income and the expenditure of Vaidic is 8 ∶ 5. If his income increases by 20% and his expenditure increases by 30%, then find the percentage increase or decrease in his monthly savings.
questions.questionHtml: The ratio between the monthly income and the expenditure of Vaidic is 8 ∶ 5. If his income increases by 20% and his expenditure increases by 30%, then find the percentage increase or decrease in his monthly savings.
questions.solution:
Let the monthly income and the expenditure of Vaidic be 8a and 5a respectively.

Income = 8a(1 + 20%) ⇒ I = 8a(1 + 0.20) ⇒ I = 9.6a

Expenditure = 5a(1 + 30%) ⇒ E = 5a(1 + 0.30) ⇒ E = 5a(1.30) = Rs. 6.5a

Savings = 9.6a - 6.5a = Rs. 3.1a

questions.question: If Rs. 72 amounts to Rs. 104.4 in 3 years, what will Rs. 120 amount to in 5 years at the same rate percent per annum?

questions.solution:
Since the rate is the same in both cases, we can use the ratio method, by calculation interest for the same number of years.

3 year interest = 104.4 - 72 = 32.4

5 year interest = 32.4 × 5/3 = 54

Let the amount on the sum of 120 be a.

⇒ (72 + 54)/72 = a/120 ⇒ 7/4 = a/120 ⇒ a = 210

questions.question: A man takes 15 minutes to row 16 km downstream, which is 25% less than the time he takes to row the same distance upstream. How many kilometres can the man row in an hour in still water? (Rounded off to nearest whole number)
questions.questionHtml: A man takes 15 minutes to row 16 km downstream, which is 25% less than the time he takes to row the same distance upstream. How many kilometres can the man row in an hour in still water? (Rounded off to nearest whole number)
questions.solution:
Let the speed of the current be x and the man’s speed be y km/hr.

16 = (x + y) × 1/4 ⇒ x + y = 64      ----(1)

25% less than the time means = 15 × 4/3 = 20 min

16 = (y - x) × 1/3  ⇒ -x + y = 48      ----(2)

Adding (1) and (2)

⇒ 2y = 112 ⇒ y = 56 km/hr

questions.question: To do a certain work, Ajay and Bharat work on alternate days, with Bharat starting the work on the first day. Ajay can finish the work alone in 32 days. If the work gets completed in exactly 8 days, then Bharat alone can finish 7 times the same work in ____________ days.
questions.questionHtml: To do a certain work, Ajay and Bharat work on alternate days, with Bharat starting the work on the first day. Ajay can finish the work alone in 32 days. If the work gets completed in exactly 8 days, then Bharat alone can finish 7 times the same work in ____________ days.
questions.solution:
A’s one day work = 1/32

B will work only 4 days A will work only: = 8 - 4 = 4 days

If A’s 4-day work = 4/32 = 1/8

Remaining work = 1 – [1/8] = 7/8

B complete 7/8 work in = 4 days

B complete whole work in = 4 × [8/7] = 32/7 days

B alone can finish 7 times the same work in = [32/7] × 7 = 32 days

questions.solution:
Total work = 60 units (LCM of 12, 15, 20)

⇒ Efficiency of C = 60/20 = 3 units/day

Remaining work = (60 - 48)/60 ⇒ 1/5

questions.question: If x > 0, and \(x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} = 254\) , what is the value of \(x^5 + \frac{1}{x^5}\) ?
questions.questionHtml: If x > 0, and \(x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} = 254\), what is the value of \(x^5 + \frac{1}{x^5}\)?
questions.solution:
\(x^5 + \frac{1}{x^5} \) = ( \(x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3} \) ) ×  ( \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} \)) - (x + 1/x)

⇒ \( [{x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}}]^2\) = 254 + 2 ⇒ \( [{x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}}]\) = 16

⇒ ​\(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2} +2 = [{x + \frac{1}{x}}]^2\)​​ ⇒ ​x + 1/x = √16+2 ⇒ ​x + 1/x = 3√2

⇒ ​x3 + 1/x3 = (3√2)3 - 3 × 3√2 ⇒ ​x3 + 1/x3 = 54√2 - 9√2 ⇒ ​x3 + 1/x3 = 45√2

⇒ \(x^5 + \frac{1}{x^5} \) = 45√2 × 16 - 3√2 ⇒ \(x^5 + \frac{1}{x^5} \) = 717√2

The correct answer is "Resembling."

Key Points
  •  Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
  • "Matching" means to have the same colour/pattern or qualities as something else.
    • Example: He wore a matching shirt with the jacket.
  • "Resembling" means to be similar or bear a likeness to something/someone.
    • Example: The new statue resembles the old one in every way.
  • From the above explanation, it is clear that the word "resembling" is the synonym of the word "matching."

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Additional Information
  • "Appointing" means to assign a job or position to someone.
  • "Distinguishing" means to recognize or differentiate something/someone from others.
  • "Adoring" means to love and admire someone/something deeply.

    • He distinguished the significant differences between the two products.
  • Adoring: पूजना, बहुत प्यार करना
    • Example: वह अपनी मां को बहुत प्यार करता है।
    • He adores his mother a lot.
  • Resembling: समानता
    • Example: उसकी आँखें उसकी माँ की आँखों के समान होती हैं।
    • His eyes resemble his mother's eyes.
